output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large value, the 'totalSupply += mintedAmount' operation can cause integer overflow and set 'totalSupply' to zero.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[msg.sender]' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value' operation can cause an integer overflow and set 'balanceOf[msg.sender]' to zero.
The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[_to] += _value' operation can cause an integer overflow and set 'balanceOf[_to]' to zero.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[_from]' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' operation can cause an integer overflow and set 'balanceOf[_from]' to zero.
The 'buy' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'msg.value' is a large value, the 'uint amount = msg.value / buyPrice' operation can cause an integer overflow and set 'amount' to zero.
